description:

For more information, you can visit the manual on our official website: https://marvelousdesigner.zendesk.com/hc/en-us/categories/360002390871-Manual

We welcome everyone to join our QQ group (after following the account or sending a private message, you will automatically receive the group number and password!).

summary: # Creating Military Uniforms in Marvelous Designer - Part 2 ## Introduction In this tutorial, we will learn how to create military uniforms using Marvelous Designer. The following steps outline the process of designing and adjusting different components of the uniform, including sleeves, collars, and pants. ## Setting Up the Garment ### Default Clothing Version First, enter the default clothing version and drag it out to the straight line point. Adjust the version by pressing the Alt key and dragging it outside of the screen. You can utilize the AI curve tool to adjust the side of the clothing and widen the overall width. ### Sleeve Adjustment When adjusting the width of the clothing, ensure that the length of the sleeve remains the same. Use the Shift key to create a guideline while adjusting the straight line point. You can also modify the curve point as necessary. - Extend the sleeve version. - Rearrange the version to solve any gaps. - Use the change length tool to modify the sleeve length, adjusting the direction as needed. ### Internal Line Creation Use the internal line tool to create internal lines, cut and sew these lines to form the sleeve. Adjust the size of the sleeve accordingly. ## Collar Design ### Collar Creation Click on the outer line of the version to measure the collar length. Use the multidirectional tool to create an equal length for the collar version. Align and arrange the collar version around the virtual model. - Use the free sewing tool, pressing the Shift key for precise sewing. - Adjust the shape of the collar to ensure that the curve of the collar plate corresponds with the collar's curve. - Click on the Alt key to adjust the curve and maintain straight corners for a flat appearance. ### Finalizing the Collar After adjusting the collar's length and curve, reaffirm if they are equal in length.
